be rooted in tradition: The Dragon Boat Festival is deeply rooted in tradition, and families still eat rice dumplings every year.
端午節深深根植於傳統，家家戶戶每年仍然會吃粽子。
root for a team: Sitting in front of the TV, my dad loves to root for a team and shout at every goal.
坐在電視機前，我爸爸很愛為球隊加油，每次進球都大聲吼叫。
root out corruption: The new mayor promised to root out corruption in the city government within his first year.
新市長承諾要在上任第一年內根除市政府的貪腐。
take root: It took several years for the new idea of recycling to take root in our small town.
資源回收這個新觀念花了好幾年才在我們的小鎮生根。
root around: I saw my brother root around in the kitchen drawers, looking for the batteries he had lost.
我看見弟弟在廚房抽屜裡到處翻找他弄丟的電池。
the root cause: Doctors believe that stress is the root cause of many of his health problems.
醫生認為壓力是他許多健康問題的根本原因。
rot in jail: The victim's family said they hoped the cruel killer would rot in jail for the rest of his life.
受害者家屬說，他們希望那個殘忍的兇手在牢裡爛掉，關一輩子。
rot the teeth: Drinking sweet soda every day can rot the teeth of young children very quickly.
每天喝含糖汽水會讓小孩子很快就蛀牙。
rot from within: Without honest leaders, even a strong company can slowly rot from within and finally fail.
沒有誠實的領導者，即使是強大的公司也會慢慢從內部腐敗，最後失敗。
round up suspects: After the bank robbery, the police began to round up suspects in the neighborhood.
銀行搶案發生後，警方開始在附近一帶圍捕嫌犯。
round off the evening: We decided to round off the evening with some ice cream and a walk along the river.
我們決定用冰淇淋和沿著河邊散步，為這個晚上畫下句點。
round down the number: If the price is 99.6 dollars, you can round down the number to 99 to keep it simple.
如果價格是99.6元，你可以無條件捨去成99，讓它簡單一點。
round out one's education: Studying abroad for a year helped her round out her education and see the world differently.
出國留學一年幫助她使教育更完整，也讓她用不同的角度看世界。
round on someone: When I asked about her grades, my sister suddenly began to round on me and shouted angrily.
當我問起她的成績時，我姊姊突然對我發怒指責，還生氣地大吼。
route traffic: During the parade, police will route traffic away from the main street to avoid accidents.
遊行期間，警方會導引交通避開主要街道，以避免發生意外。
be routed through: All phone calls from customers are routed through the main office before they reach us.
所有客戶來電在轉到我們這裡之前，都會經由總辦公室傳送。
en route: We stopped at a small café en route to the airport because we had plenty of time.
我們在前往機場的途中，停在一家小咖啡館，因為時間還很充裕。
route calls: The new system can route calls to the right department, so customers don't have to wait long.
新系統能把電話轉接到正確的部門，所以客戶不用等很久。
rub salt into the wound: I already feel bad about failing the test, so please don't rub salt into the wound by laughing at me.
我已經因為考試不及格很難過了，所以請不要嘲笑我，在我傷口上灑鹽。
rub shoulders with: At the film festival, young actors get the chance to rub shoulders with famous directors.
在電影節上，年輕演員有機會與知名導演交往。
rub off on: I hope my roommate's good study habits will rub off on me before the final exams.
我希望室友良好的讀書習慣能在期末考前影響到我。
rub someone the wrong way: His rude jokes always rub someone the wrong way, so people try to avoid him at parties.
他無禮的玩笑總是會惹惱某人，所以大家在派對上都盡量避開他。
rub it in: I know I lost the game, so please don't rub it in by reminding me again and again.
我知道我輸了比賽，所以請不要一再提醒我，戳我的痛處。
rub out: The teacher asked us to rub out the wrong answers with an eraser and try again.
老師要我們用橡皮擦擦掉錯誤的答案，再試一次。
ruin one's chances: One serious injury could ruin his chances of making the national basketball team this year.
一次嚴重的受傷就可能毀掉他今年入選國家籃球隊的機會。
ruin one's reputation: One false story on social media can ruin a person's reputation in just a few hours.
社群媒體上一則不實的報導，就能在短短幾小時內毀掉一個人的名聲。
ruin the surprise: Don't tell Mom about the birthday party, or you will ruin the surprise we planned for weeks.
不要告訴媽媽生日派對的事，不然你會破壞我們計畫了好幾週的驚喜。
be financially ruined: After the bad investment, the family was financially ruined and had to sell their house.
那次投資失利後，這家人破產了，只好賣掉房子。
ruin one's health: Working long hours without sleep will ruin your health and leave you too weak to enjoy life.
長時間工作又不睡覺會損害你的健康，讓你虛弱到無法享受人生。
in ruins: After the strong earthquake, the old temple was in ruins, and people cried at the sight.
強烈地震過後，那座古廟成為廢墟，人們看到都哭了。
